script: Rahim (Farmgate) reports a phone snatching at the bus stand, anonymously.
Nila, Tanvir and Rafiq confirm it. It's verified and referred to Tejgaon Thana.
Tejgaon Thana acknowledges and starts work. Rahim sees the official update.
The admin view shows Rahim's name; the public sees "Anonymous".
Shirin (Mirpur) sends a missing-child SOS. Arif, watching Mirpur 10, gets the banner.
Arif posts a sighting. Shirin marks the child found. Everyone gets "Found safe".
Open the dashboard: Farmgate's high-urgency count went up.
